description: In an interview with "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King, Melinda spoke out about her distaste of Jeffrey Epstein and her ex-husand's affliation with him.
headline: Melinda French Gates Indicates that Ex-Husband Bill Gates's Meetings and Seeming Friendship with Epstein was a Contributing Factor in Their Divorce

info.description: Further information about Melinda French Gates' relationship to Epstein was revealed in the second major document dump associated with the Epstein Files Transparency Act on 2025-01-30.
